item: a page whose store keeps failing is asked for less and less, and its error names the constraint it broke
summary: Windows run 2026-11-07: three pages failed with an IntegrityError every drain they were asked for (18, 10 and 9 times in 3.4 h) and the driver text is withheld, so the constraint was unknown. The catch-up's wait after an attempt doubles with each consecutive store failure (backlog_cooldown, process memory only, cleared by a store that works, a restart forgets it) and the error and the log line carry constraint_of(exc): kind plus table.column read only from a line that matches SQLite's fixed shape whole, never other driver text.
